_source: experiments/2026-10-05-placement-b70/ (B-results.txt, C-*.json/.mem, A-*.json); medians of 3; card SYCL0 0000:0b:00.0; 27B = Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_S, MoE = Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_XL

D._note: async stream pool (bb6dcb55) vs the section-A/B sync build, same host, llama-server on SYCL0, ctx 4096, -ctk q8_0 -fa on, temp 0, n_predict 32, model on tmpfs (warm reads), median of 6 (2 rounds x 3 prompts). n0 = GGML_STREAM_RESIDENT_LAYERS=0, n62 = 62/65.
D.async_server: llama-stream-v3 build of the bb6dcb55 patch pair

window._note: common-window aggregate: 4 concurrent 96-token requests across 2 servers, total tokens / elapsed wall seconds. Replaces per-instance t/s sums which overstate steady-state.

delivered._accounting_window: cumulative pool-lifetime counters (pool build -> teardown), not a decode window; includes warmup, prompt processing and decode. n0_h2d_gbps is bytes/whole-lifetime seconds (~390 s implied), not a steady-state PCIe utilization measurement - hardware PCIe counters are unavailable on this host (xe PMU exposes GT events only; sysman pci stats stubbed)

D.parity: streamed output byte-identical sync vs async (24 tokens, temp 0)
D.multidevice: tensor-split 1.5B over SYCL0+SYCL1: per-device pools (84/70 tensors), decode 9.2 t/s, pools drained 13.39/11.27 GiB per card

models.moe: Qwen1.5-MoE-14.3B-A2.7B Q3_K_M (24 layers; section D only - NOT the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B used in sections A-C)

D.warmup: 1 discarded request per server start; 6 timed requests per arm (2 rounds x 3 prompts)
